g.text: and the engineering of fusion power

g.title: Tokamak — Handle the exhaust
g.desc: An exhaust region called the divertor receives particles and heat. A proposed D–T plant also needs a blanket to capture neutron energy and breed tritium. Schematic, not to scale. Blue lines are magnetic fields, orange indicates plasma or particle energy, and mint indicates electrical or driver energy. Lines are conceptual, not simulated particle trajectories.
